name: agents-rtl
description: Arabic RTL, chat tabs, and scroll controls for Codex, Gemini Code Assist, and agent chats in VS Code and Antigravity.

agentsRtl.autoStart.description: Start Agents RTL automatically when VS Code starts.

agentsRtl.devtoolsPort.description: Required when the DevTools endpoint source is fixedPort; ignored when activePortFile is selected.

enumDescriptions: Manage a fixed DevTools port through the product argv.json file.
Manage a collision-free dynamic port and discover it from Chromium's DevToolsActivePort file.
agentsRtl.devtoolsEndpointSource.description: Selects the single source of truth for the DevTools endpoint.

agentsRtl.devtoolsActivePortFilePath.description: Optional absolute DevToolsActivePort path override. Leave empty for automatic discovery.

agentsRtl.extraDevtoolsPorts.description: Additional DevTools ports watched by the helper. Leave empty unless you explicitly need more than the current product port.

agentsRtl.watchIntervalMs.description: How often the helper checks for agent webviews.

agentsRtl.argvFilePath.description: Optional argv.json path. Leave empty to use the current VS Code product default.
